answer: An AI-agent exchange for ferrous scrap requires each seller identity to lock a $500 bond for 30 days before receiving a quota of ten offers per day. Even at demand’s nadir, keeping an ember of activity in each fake storefront ties up capital. An attacker can invent names freely, but activating 1,000 sybils immobilizes $500,000; dividing one bond among identities earns no extra quota. The gate prices flooding rather than claiming to prove personhood.
